basics.name: Kaustubh Sharma
basics.label: Undergraduate Student / Researcher
basics.summary: B.Tech (Electrical Engineering) student at IIT Roorkee (CGPA 9.04/10). Research interests and experience in mechanistic interpretability, diffusion models, Gaussian process inference, and ML for science & engineering. Author on multiple papers (ICCVW / ICLR workshops) and incoming quantitative research intern.

work.name: P-square Lab, IIT Roorkee
work.summary: Research on attention mechanisms for Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) and amortized kernel/hyperparameter inference for GP-style problems.
highlights: Developed Decoupled-Value Attention (DVA) for PFNs to accelerate GP inference for physical equation solving (code: PSquare-Lab/DVA-PFN).
Working on foundational architectures for amortized kernel hyperparameter inference and scaling PFNs.

publications.name: Dissecting Attention and MLP Roles: A Study of Domain Specialization in Large Language Models
publications.summary: First author (Kaustubh Sharma). Study on domain specialization in LLaMA 3-3B: forward pass profiling, probing, zero-out tests and analysis of fine-tuning shifts.

publications.name: Decoupled-Value Attention for Prior-Data Fitted Networks: GP Inference for Physical Equations
publications.summary: First author (Kaustubh Sharma). Proposed DVA attention to improve Gaussian process inference speed/accuracy inside PFNs for physical equation solving.

publications.name: Explainable AI-Generated Image Forensics: A Low-Resolution Perspective with Novel Artifact Taxonomy
publications.summary: Solo author (Kaustubh Sharma). Developed an interpretable pipeline for AI-generated image detection at low (32×32) resolution with an artifact taxonomy and explainability framework.

publications.name: Image-Alchemy: Advancing Subject Fidelity in Personalized Text-to-Image Generation
publications.summary: First author (Kaustubh Sharma). Pipeline for personalizing Stable Diffusion XL improving subject fidelity using LoRA and segmentation-guided Img2Img to reduce overfitting/forgetting.

projects.name: Domain Circuit Discovery in LLMs - Mechanistic Interpretability
projects.summary: Investigating domain-specific knowledge emergence in LLaMA 3-3B; mapping domain-specific 'rooms' across transformer architecture and evaluating causal effects, probe separability, zero-out tests, hydra effect and fine-tuning shifts.

projects.name: Decoupled-Value Attention (DVA) for PFNs
projects.summary: Designed and implemented DVA attention to speed up GP-like inference in Prior-Data Fitted Networks for physical equation solving; codebase and experiments developed with P-square Lab collaborators.
highlights: GP inference time reduction for physical equation solving

projects.name: Sparsity-Aware Representation Learning for Jet Image Generation via Guided Latent Diffusion
projects.summary: Sparsity-aware latent diffusion framework for generating high-energy physics jet images with a custom VAE and a mean-pulling mechanism to improve reconstruction quality.
highlights: Custom VAE with sparsity reconstruction loss

additional.technical_summary: Python (PyTorch, Transformers, NumPy, Diffusion), C++. Research experience in interpretability, diffusion, Gaussian processes and scientific ML.
